channel.title: ATEQ VT600 Series Tester official releases

item.title: ATEQ VT600 Series Tester 8.51.0
item.description: ATEQ VT600 Series Tester 8.51.0: signed official update notifications and manual Check for updates. Adds the Modbus DLL selector for serial connections. V6 (Table VX) is the default. V7 (Table VX) and legacy 64-bit V5.2 are also included. Restart the app after changing the selection.
